dedupe_keys.name: montevideo household waste container lifts and final disposal data container emptying records by circuit four monthly csv since 2024 last 24 hours and monthly tonnages at the felipe cardoso landfill

description: Montevideo's municipal government publishes operational data on how the city's household waste is collected and disposed of. The main data set records every emptying of a household waste container in the city's system of 117 collection circuits, each with about 100 containers, released as CSV files for each four-month period from January 2024 to April 2026 plus a resource with the lifts of the last 24 hours. A second data set gives the monthly tonnages of solid waste by type received at the Felipe Cardoso final disposal site, a 77 hectare landfill. The Montevidata environmental observatory explains both with charts. Coverage is the department of Montevideo. The data are free and available to download from the city's CKAN portal under Uruguay's open data licence. Caveats: the files document lifts, not weights per container, the field documentation is thin, and the disposal data set is updated less often than the lift records. Simulation uses: optimising collection routes and frequencies, detecting service gaps by circuit, and modelling the flow from containers to sorting plants and landfill. Related records: the Bahía Blanca collection routing instances (data-bahia-blanca-waste-collection-routing-instances) use similar container data for route optimisation, and the bin fill level sensor data (data-composition-bin-fill-level-sensors) add fill measurements.
